description: Implementation of IEEE 802.15.4 security features including session setup, encryption, decryption, and context management for 6LoWPAN authentication and encryption.

methods.name: ieee802154_security_setup_session
methods.description: Sets up encryption and decryption sessions with specified security level, key mode, and key.

methods.name: ieee802154_security_teardown_session
methods.description: Tears down the security session, freeing associated cryptographic resources.

methods.name: prepare_cipher_aead_pkt
methods.description: Prepares the AEAD packet structure for encryption or decryption based on security level and frame details.

methods.name: ieee802154_decrypt_auth
methods.description: Performs decryption and authentication of a frame using the security context.

methods.name: ieee802154_encrypt_auth
methods.description: Performs encryption and authentication of a frame using the security context.

methods.name: ieee802154_security_init
methods.description: Initializes the security context, setting up cryptographic device and parameters.
